records.failureSummary: Implemented the HTTP infrastructure slice for TaskBoard with Node standard library only. Files: src/config.js (PORT default 3000 validated as an integer 0-65535, DATA_DIR default ./data resolved to an absolute path, recursive mkdir plus directory and writability checks at startup, no ambient process.env fallback when an explicit env object is passed); src/logger.js (JSON-line stdout-only logger with debug/info/warn/error/child, key-based deep redaction of password/secret/token/authorization/hash/salt/cookie/session fields, free-form scrubbing of Bearer tokens and password= [REDACTED] style text, circular/depth guards, never throws on EPIPE, level configurable via LOG_LEVEL, silent level available); src/errors.js (single envelope {"error":{"code","message"}}, full PRD allow-list of 8 codes frozen, createErrorBody and HttpError refuse any code outside the list, helpers validationError/unknownFieldError/unauthorizedError/notFoundError, sendJson/sendError/sendNoContent and sendErrorResponse that maps known HttpErrors to their status and hides internal details); src/http/router.js (method plus path-pattern route table with literal and :param segments, decode-safe param extraction, 2048-byte path cap, duplicate-slash and trailing-slash normalisation, route listing for diagnostics); src/http/body.js (256 KiB capped JSON reader that rejects oversized, aborted, malformed and non-object bodies as 400 VALIDATION_ERROR instead of crashing); src/routes/health.js (unauthenticated GET /healthz, /health, /ready returning 200 {"status":"ok"}); src/server.js (createTaskBoardServer(config, options) preserved as the public factory, builds the route table, registers health routes, owns JSON body parsing helpers in the handler context, returns 404 {"error":{"code":"NOT_FOUND","message":"Resource not found"}} for unknown routes and unsupported methods, converts malformed request targets into 400 VALIDATION_ERROR, logs one redacted request line per request with path only (no query, headers or body), keeps clientError handling from killing the process, and main() reads PORT/DATA_DIR, logs the listening line to stdout and shuts down cleanly on SIGTERM/SIGINT). Trust-boundary input is validated: env values, paths, URLs, body size, JSON syntax and error codes are all checked before use, and no credential, token, hash or secret reaches stdout. Verified: node --test test/health.ac01.test.js -> 6/6 pass, exit 0; npm run lint, npm run typecheck, npm run build -> exit 0; npm run build confirms the entrypoint still loads and exports createTaskBoardServer; the login suite run shows an unknown POST /api/register producing exactly the allowed 404 envelope. The auth and task routes are intentionally out of scope for this task and remain for their own backend slices, so the pre-existing register/login/persistence suites are still red for missing endpoints (they were red before this change as well). A new test file test/infra.contract.test.js was attempted to cover unknown-route and body-parsing contracts but the write policy rejected the test/ path for this backend task, so no test file was added and nothing was written elsewhere instead.
